summary: One blocker: tickets/v2-issue-map.md and tickets/map-P2.md still describe the v2 DB model as 'one writer per file; ADR 0001 multi-writer gone' for #1056 and #988. Git archaeology on cm-main shows ADR-0001 (v1.0.130, 11e39301) is a regression-proof decision that SessionDB/ContentStore are explicitly multi-writer-safe, reached after v1.0.128's single-writer lockfile (db-lock.ts) caused a real regression (DatabaseLockedError blocked legitimate multi-window users) that had to be rolled back. v2's actual ADR-0002 (accepted, r3 Q6) does NOT reintroduce single-writer: it keeps multiple writers with BEGIN IMMEDIATE + node:sqlite timeout and has 'the last server to close runs the checkpoint', consistent with ADR-0001, not a reversal of it. So the ADR-0002 is fine; the ticket docs' characterization is the stale/wrong part and should be corrected before anyone reads #1056/#988 as 'decision needed to revert to single-writer'.

items.ref: ADR-0002 (one context.db per project, multi-writer via BEGIN IMMEDIATE + node:sqlite timeout); r3 Q6 'last server to close runs the checkpoint'
items.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY (the decision this PR's framing contradicts): 11e39301 'docs(adr): SessionDB is multi-writer-safe (v1.0.130 slice 8)' and 54ec1be7 'fix(util): delete db-lock.ts - single-writer primitive obsolete'. ORIGINAL_INTENT (quoted from ADR-0001, docs/adr/0001-sessiondb-multi-writer.md in cm-main): 'SessionDB is multi-writer-safe... SQLiteBase ctor MUST NOT apply any single-writer enforcement' - this reversed v1.0.128's single-writer lockfile (acquireDbLock/DatabaseLockedError) after it caused a real regression: 'multi-window users... hit DatabaseLockedError and could not work'. REGRESSION_RISK (blocker-level): tickets/v2-issue-map.md:451 and tickets/map-P2.md row #1056 both still describe the v2 model to a reader as 'D3 (one writer per file; ADR 0001 multi-writer gone)'. That phrase is factually wrong against the actual accepted ADR-0002, and if taken literally by an implementer it would reintroduce exactly the v1.0.128 single-writer-lock regression ADR-0001 rolled back (DatabaseLockedError blocking legitimate concurrent sessions). SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: any v2 checkpoint/mmap work must keep multiple writers on one file (BEGIN IMMEDIATE, node:sqlite timeout:5000, no app-level retry loop per ADR-0002), and must only decide WHO checkpoints (r3 Q6: last server to close) - never reintroduce an open-time single-writer lock.
items.fix_commits: 11e39301, 54ec1be7, 302bb7b8 (node:sqlite migration also removed better-sqlite3's multi-process ABI issues)
items.regressions: the exact regression class (single-writer lock blocking legitimate multi-window use) already happened once in v1.0.128-129 and was rolled back in v1.0.130; the ticket docs' 'ADR 0001 multi-writer gone' phrasing, if acted on, reopens it
